briefing: NASDAQ +1.7% and S&P500 +1.1% confirm a risk-on session, so we're deploying idle cash into three open slots with strong, multi-signal momentum names. Existing 7 positions are held unchanged since none are showing stop-loss or profit-target triggers.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum investing means buying stocks that are already trending upward, based on the idea that rising prices tend to keep rising in the short term. Today's buys were chosen because they showed multiple bullish technical signals together — like MACD crossovers and prices above their moving averages — which suggests real buying interest rather than a random blip.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能投資是指買入已經處於上升趨勢的股票，其理念是短期內上漲的股價往往會持續上漲。今天選擇買入的股票都同時出現多個看漲技術訊號（例如MACD黃金交叉、股價站上均線），顯示背後有真實的買盤支撐，而不只是偶然的短暫波動。

market_education.summary_en: Broad gains across the NASDAQ (+1.7%) and S&P 500 (+1.1%) point to a risk-on rally where investors rotated back into growth and momentum names. No specific catalyst headlines were provided for today, so this move appears driven by broad-based buying rather than a single news event. Momentum indicators (MACD, RSI, price vs. moving averages) across dozens of screened tickers turned bullish simultaneously, consistent with a market-wide sentiment shift rather than isolated stock news.
market_education.summary_zh: 納斯達克指數上漲1.7%，標普500上漲1.1%，顯示市場出現風險偏好回升的走勢，資金重新流入成長及動能股。今日並未提供具體的新聞觸發事件，這波上漲較可能是由廣泛的買盤帶動，而非單一消息面因素。多檔篩選股票的動能指標（MACD、RSI、均線位置）同步轉為看漲，反映的是全市場情緒轉變，而非個別公司的新聞。
